home.heroLead:
Nationality and experience both become strengths here.
Teammates from Vietnam, Thailand, Brazil and more support global industry from Fukui.
home.s1Title: See the teammates who work here.
home.s1Lead: People are the lead. A character gallery introducing each member — you may well find a senior from your own country.
home.s2Lead: We take on the work behind the scenes and support the front line. There's a place here for you.
home.s3Lead: Buddy program, multilingual support, visualised skills… we build retention, growth and belonging as systems (some proposed / in planning).
home.s4Lead: Exact figures are under review and will appear here once confirmed.

about.headLead: 'Contract', 'dispatch', 'homework' — the words sound stiff, but what we do is take on someone's work and be trusted with it, whole.
about.philoQuote:
As a bridge for people, goods and companies,
we give total support to the global business
of every industry.
about.roleLead: We stand between people, goods and companies, and connect them. That is our role.
about.bizTitle: Our business, from your point of view
about.bizLead: We've translated what each business can mean as a 'place' for you.

members.headLead: We introduce our teammates one by one. Filter by department or home country to find a senior close to you.

jobs.headLead: Whether you're starting from scratch or want to use your languages, you can choose a place where your strengths come alive. (Detailed conditions under review.)

grow.headLead: Not 'join and that's it', but days where you think 'I want to be here.' We build retention, growth and belonging as systems.
grow.intro: The programs below include some already running and some we propose to introduce or are still considering. Each card states its status (actual status TBC).
grow.ctaLead: Everyone's path is different. In regular talks, we map it at your pace.

future.headLead: Adding the power of technology to contract, dispatch and homework. We're envisioning new services that help workers and clients alike.
future.note: The following are not finalised services but ideas under consideration. Feasibility and timing are undecided (we avoid exaggeration).

numbers.headLead: Multinational ratio, retention and more — us, in numbers. We don't post figures we can't source. Confirmed values will appear over time.

faq.headLead: Answers to worries and questions before you apply. Answers include items still under review.
faq.foot: Answers are proposal-based and official replies are [TBC]. If anything else is on your mind, ask us anything in a casual interview.
